calls.title: Second Nature + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Nir Altmark (VP of Engineering at Second Nature) discussed replacing their internal feature toggle system with GrowthBook, primarily for feature flags, but found the Pro plan ($40/user/month for ~30 users) too expensive. Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales) explained enterprise self-hosted pricing starts at $50k/year and offered to explore a discount in exchange for a case study. Next steps: Christian will check on pricing options, and Nir will discuss with founders or consider starting with fewer users.

calls.title: Second Nature + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion addressed Growth Book's pricing structures for both cloud and self-hosted enterprise solutions to meet the budget needs of Second Nature AI. Key highlights included the Pro plan's cost of $40 per user per month for up to 50 users, which would total approximately $2,000 monthly for Second Nature AI's 30 users. The self-hosted minimum cost is $50,000 per year for 10 licenses, deemed advantageous for security and flexibility. Nir expressed interest in starting with the Pro plan to evaluate its value. The conversation also explored potential discounts related to a joint case study. Misunderstandings about the company identities were clarified, emphasizing the need for clear communication.
calls.keywords: Feature flags, GrowthBook pricing, Self-hosted solution, Enterprise plan, Pro plan, Case study discount
